title: Universal Computer-Use Architecture, Semantic Entity Resolution & General Agent Execution
platform: Windows 11 (AMD64, 16 GB RAM, RTX 2050 4 GB VRAM)

hardware_budget.architecture_paradigm: Dual-engine hybrid (Laya deterministic fast-path + Spark reasoning + UIA/CDP grounding)

modules_created.description: Unified computer_use package entrypoint exposing ComputerUse facade and data models
Contract models: ComputerUseObservation, UIElement, UIAction, VerificationCondition, VerificationResult, RecoveryAction
ComputerUse facade unifying observe(), discover(), resolve(), find_element(), interact(), verify(), recover()

Comprehensive research synthesis of Microsoft UFO2, UIA, OmniParser, Browser Use, CDP, and OSWorld-V2 within 4GB VRAM constraints

Added compilation rules for find_application and is_application_running; generalized close_application
Integrated negation safety guard, generalized close/quit verbs, and wired in SemanticEntityResolver
Generalized tabbed window handling into TABBED_APPLICATION_ADAPTERS rather than app-specific hardcoding
Generalized invariant violation recovery relaunch logic for arbitrary applications
Replaced hardcoded calc/notepad aliases with dynamic entity resolution
Added fast early handlers for negation safety, conversational queries, computational tasks, and read-only observation queries

application_specific_cleanups.resolution: Removed hardcoded alias checks; queries now resolve dynamically through SemanticEntityResolver and SearchIndex
Resolved by pure-Python .lnk physical target resolution and maintenance exclusion filter; canonical executable stem boosted
